description: This file implements a login screen widget in Flutter, managing user input, validation, and navigation upon login attempts.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays the login form, handles user authentication, and navigates to the home screen upon success.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class for LoginScreen, manages form state, user input controllers, loading and error states, and UI building.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Handles form validation, triggers login via auth provider, manages loading/error states, and navigates to home screen on success.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of email and password text controllers.

methods.name: _buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the header widget with welcome text.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the entire login screen widget with form fields, buttons, and layout.
